Gilla Merrun is one of the customers waiting in line at the Counting House in the Lower City.
“
You don't understand. Barek doesn't understand. The way Ringmaster Lucretious looked at me...
„
— Gilla Merrun

Involvement

Gilla stands in line waiting her turn to get serviced by  Clerk Chervis, an employee of the Counting House who appears to be very busy. She is withdrawing money to buy a stake in Circus of the Last Days, mentioning the way  Lucretious looked at her. Behind her  Brialavant is waiting impatiently and comments about Gilla losing her mind.
